description: Renovate proposes updates; nothing merges without passing CI (blueprint section 6.3). Pins that carry a SHA-256 beside them, cosign in packaging/install.sh and in the workflows and gitleaks in ci.yml, are updated by hand as docs/maintaining.md describes.

packageRules.description: One pull request a week for the workflows' actions

The Go toolchain and go directive move together, never automatically to a new major
